title: Tori by TalkJS – AI support for customer success
excerpt: Tori helps customer success teams answer complex questions from help docs, product pages, and company knowledge.
content_html:
The smartestAI support agent forcustomer success

Meet Tori, your AI support agent. Set up in minutes.

Try for free
WHAT IS TORI?

Tori learns your product in depth from the content you already have, then delivers accurate answers to even the most complex customer questions through a UI you can fully customize.

BUILT ON TALKJS

Production-grade messaging, real-time delivery, and full conversation history come standard. Tori is built on TalkJS, the same infrastructure powering millions of real conversations across the web.

Run it in your help center, app, or website. Tori stays in sync and hands off to your team with full context when a customer needs a human.

SETUP IN MINUTES

From URL to live support

01CONNECT

https://yourproduct.com

Connect URL

Paste your URL

Connect your help center, docs, or product site.

02LEARN

HELP✓

WEBSITE✓

GUIDES✓

UPDATES✓

Sitemap up to date

Tori learns your product

Your product content becomes grounded knowledge.

03EMBED

Ask Tori

How can I help?

Add Tori to your site

Embed the chat UI in your docs, app, or website.

HOW TORI WORKS

Support that never clocks out

STEP 01

Understand the question

Tori identifies what each customer needs and brings the right product context into the conversation.

STEP 02

Respond in your voice

Your tone, guidance, and rules keep every answer aligned with how your team supports customers.

STEP 03

Answer instantly

Customers get clear, sourced answers in the moment, without waiting in a support queue.

STEP 04

Escalate seamlessly

When human help is needed, Tori passes the conversation to your team with the context intact.

FEATURES

Answers what it knows. Escalates what it doesn’t.

KNOWLEDGE

One source of truth

Bring scattered support content into one dependable knowledge layer for every conversation.

ACCURACY

Knows its limits

Flags uncertainty instead of filling gaps, and brings in your team when confidence runs low.

HANDOFF

Context included

Agents get the conversation and sources, ready to continue without making customers repeat.

CUSTOMIZATION

Make it yours

Built on TalkJS, Tori lets you shape the interface and behavior to match your product.

SETUP

Fits your stack

Use the ready-made chat UI, customize the experience, or connect Tori through the API.

SECURITY

Built to scale

SSO, data controls, and TalkJS infrastructure give support teams a dependable foundation.

SECURITY

Enterprise-grade security & privacy

Tori is built for support teams that need accurate answers without compromising customer trust. Your data stays yours, every conversation is protected, and compliance is part of the foundation.

DATA

Your data stays yours

Tori uses your knowledge to answer customers. GDPR-ready controls help keep personal data protected.

ENCRYPTION

Encrypted data

Customer conversations, connected content, and support context are protected end to end.

COMPLIANCE

ISO 27001 certified

Built on ISO 27001 certified TalkJS infrastructure, with controls for production support teams.

PRICING

Start small. Grow with Tori.

Choose the right plan for your team. All prices in USD, per month.
